command:
set -euo pipefail
printf "bridge_declarations\n"
if ! rg -n "class [A-Za-z0-9_]*Bridge|struct [A-Za-z0-9_]*Bridge" src --glob "*.cppm" --glob "*.hpp"; then
  printf "none\n"
fi
printf "adapter_declarations\n"
rg -n "class [A-Za-z0-9_]*Adapter|struct [A-Za-z0-9_]*Adapter" src --glob "*.cppm" --glob "*.hpp" || true
printf "current_renderer_adapter_production_consumers\n"
rg -l "MakeCurrentRenderer|ValidateCurrentRenderer|kCurrentRenderer" src |
  rg -v "Graphics.CurrentRendererContractAdapter.(cppm|cpp)" | sort
printf "imgui_adapter_production_consumers\n"
rg -l "\bImGuiAdapter\b" src |
  rg -v "Runtime.ImGuiAdapter.(cppm|cpp)" | sort
printf "adapter_test_consumers\n"
rg -l "CurrentRendererContractAdapter|\bImGuiAdapter\b" tests | sort
